title: Set criterion verification policy
statement: As a product manager, I can specify the coverage kinds and automation levels required for an acceptance criterion so readiness reflects the assurance appropriate to that obligation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Without an explicit quality policy, an accepted criterion requires positive coverage and does not restrict the test automation level.
A current policy can require any non-empty subset of positive, negative, and edge coverage kinds for one exact criterion revision, and quality reports each required kind separately.
A current policy can allow any non-empty subset of manual, hybrid, and automated tests; a linked test outside that set is reported as automation not allowed and does not satisfy the criterion.
When a criterion revision changes, the previous policy is reported stale, its required kinds remain required, and the criterion stays uncovered until a current policy supersedes it.
